headline: Library extends evening opening
previous: The town library closed at 18:00 on weekdays.
today: A four-week pilot extends Tuesday and Thursday opening to 21:00.
unknown: Attendance and whether the pilot will become permanent are unknown.

headline: Bus pilot adds two evening departures
previous: The last Route 4 departure was at 20:00.
today: A two-week pilot adds departures at 21:00 and 22:00 on Fridays.
unknown: Passenger numbers and continuation after the pilot are unknown.

headline: Community garden opens applications
previous: Applications were closed while plots were measured.
today: Twenty plots are available and applications close next Friday.
unknown: Demand and the final allocation of plots are unknown.
